name: Reveal
insp: theatrical stage reveals and launch-night title sequences
desc: Theatre for a tax firm. Thick blue and green brand slabs, lit like a stage, swing open on load to reveal the headline over the 4K brand render; then a pinned curtain call opens on the team, the four services and the award in turn.
fx: Lit 3D brand slabs with bevelled edges swing open on load
A moving spotlight passes across the headline
Pinned curtain call: panels open on the team, the services and the award as you scroll
A soft stage light sweeps across each heading as it arrives
A brand panel turns away like a page between major sections
